findings.one_line: The proposal promised selector-conditional uniform normality under its declared positive-variance class, but the delivered positive theorem is only on the materially strengthened finite-row stabilized class; state this as a scope substitution in the headline positioning and explain why the broad-class impossibility is the replacement contribution.

The cited fixed-role proximal inference and semiparametric-proximal sources lack relevance/comparison sentences, so the theorem-level positioning does not yet explain precisely why their influence-function or fixed-role results do not already cover the switched-valid-role limit.
Remove the non-archival active-work bibliographic item from the paper-facing bibliography/positioning; unreviewed active work is not admissible in-repository prior art or a theorem comparator.
